zh.name: 惊梦剧团的圆幕先生
zh.desc: 匹诺康尼的服务器械，因梦境中的情绪干扰而陷入失控。\n原本是电视节目中的娱乐演员，失控后仍在演绎自己多变的身份，为观众带来惊喜或是惊吓。

skill_list.skill_desc: 使指定我方单体恢复能量。只能在【惊喜频道】状态下使用。
对我方全体造成少量量子属性伤害，并使我方全体能量减少。只能在【惊吓频道】状态下使用。
将【惊喜频道】状态转变为【惊吓频道】状态。

en.name: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen
en.desc: Penacony's service machinery that got out of control due to the emotional interference in the Dreamscape.\nOriginally an entertainer in TV shows, it is still portraying its ever-changing roles after losing control and continues to bring surprises or scares to the audience.

skill_list.skill_desc: Regenerates Energy for a target. This ability can only be used while under the Surprise Channel state.
Deals minor Quantum DMG to all targets and causes all targets' Energy to be reduced. This ability can only be used while in the Fright Channel state.
